caption: The video captures a heavily overexposed, dreamy close-up of a flowering branch, with pink double cherry blossoms on the left beneath yellow-green leaves against a blown-out pale sky. The floral subject drifts slowly upward and slightly rightward within the frame, the upper leaves becoming progressively more cropped at the top edge while the layout of leaves to blossoms stays roughly constant. As the bright, hazy glare shifts across the image, the pink blossoms grow somewhat more defined and saturated toward the middle before softening again. A small green-teal chromatic flare appears on the upper-right leaf and persists. A soft white circular lens-flare disc emerges near the right edge of the blossom cluster, moving slightly relative to the flowers. Slight positional shifts affect the leaves and blossoms throughout.
